subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Break the ice

options.text: Make people meeting first time feel uncomfortable
Make people meeting first time feel sad
Make people meeting first time feel more detached
Make people meeting the first time feel more comfortable

solution:
The correct answer is: **Make people meeting the first time feel more comfortable**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The idiom "**Break the ice**" means to do or say something that makes people who do not know each other feel more comfortable. (ऐसा कुछ करना या कहना जो उन लोगों को अधिक सहज महसूस कराता है जो एक-दूसरे को नहीं जानते हैं)

 
 
• Example - *That joke really broke the ice__ at the conference; we all relaxed afterwards.*
 
 
 
• So, it is clear that the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom "**Break the ice**" is "**Make people meeting the first time feel more comfortable**"
 
• Hence, the correct answer is option 4.
